findings.title: Unused `v: ^View` parameter in draw_family_wash and draw_family_wash_disc
findings.detail: Neither proc body references `v`; the parameter is dead weight on both new wash procs and misleads readers into expecting view state use.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the `v` parameter from both procs (they are pure dst/color functions), or use it if scale-dependent behavior was intended.

findings.title: Wash alignment depends on duplicated dst/index/target computation around sprite_blit
findings.evidence:
dst, ok := sprite_blit_dst(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
		sprite_blit(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
findings.detail: sprite_index_puck and sprite_puck_target are each called twice per router (same pattern in draw_building for idx/target). If sprite_blit's internal rect ever diverges from sprite_blit_dst, the wash silently misaligns.
findings.recommended_fix: Have sprite_blit return its dst rect (or accept a precomputed dst) so the wash consumes the blit's own geometry.

+	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 5, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))

findings.evidence:
(rect for buildings, disc for pucks; 4% inset keeps the silhouette edge)
...

findings.detail: Rect wash uses 0.92 (4% per side) but the puck disc uses radius factor 0.94, a 6% inset — the PR body's single 4% figure contradicts the disc code.

findings.title: blur_gate.py out-of-frame sample raises uncaught exception; setup error exits as 'gate red'
findings.evidence:
for name, tx, ty in SPAWNS:
        x, y = node_screen(tx, ty)
        r, g, b = blurred.getpixel((int(round(x)), int(round(y))))
...
Exit code 0 = gate green, 1 = gate red, 2 = usage/setup error.
findings.detail: A wrong-size image or a changed view fit puts samples off-frame; getpixel raises, Python exits 1 — indistinguishable from a measured gate failure despite the documented exit-2 contract.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap sampling in try/except printing a setup error with sys.exit(2); assert img.size == (1280, 720) before sampling.

findings.title: --sigma/--out with a missing value are silently ignored, gate runs at defaults
findings.detail: A trailing flag without a value fails the length guard and is dropped without complaint; the gate then measures sigma 6 while the operator believes otherwise. Unknown args are also accepted silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Error with exit 2 when a flag lacks a value or an unknown argument appears.

findings.title: draw_type_chip lacks the fam.a==0 guard its sibling washes have — role .None draws an empty chip
findings.detail: Terminal_Role includes .None; terminal_family returns alpha-0 for it. draw_family_wash skips, but draw_type_chip has no such guard — a role-less terminal still gets a paper chip with no glyph.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate the chip on fam.a != 0 alongside chip_visible, or validate role before drawing.

findings.title: Spec said "reuse" existing tray icons; none exist and the PR-body claim overstates the resemblance
findings.detail: Briefing item 2: "the tray icons already exist — reuse them". The tray chips are rect + text labels (draw_text), not per-role glyphs; draw_type_chip invents a new glyph set. Deviation is documented but the 'same rect+glyph recipe' claim overstates it.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the PR-body wording, or extract a shared chip+glyph proc if the tray later adopts silhouette glyphs.

findings.title: blur_gate.py hardcodes a Python mirror of the Odin view fit — second source of truth
findings.evidence:
# the view_compute fit (app/render/view.odin): tile_px 26, world 40x30 tiles,
# window 1280x720, scale = min fit, offsets centered.
TILE_PX = 26
WORLD_W_TILES, WORLD_H_TILES = 40, 30
WIN_W, WIN_H = 1280, 720


def node_screen(tx, ty):
    wx, wy = tx * TILE_PX, ty * TILE_PX
    world_w, world_h = WORLD_W_TILES * TILE_PX, WORLD_H_TILES * TILE_PX
    scale = min(WIN_W / world_w, WIN_H / world_h)
findings.detail: The sampler's fit math duplicates view_compute's constants with no cross-check; a future window/tile change makes the gate sample wrong pixels while still printing authoritative-looking numbers.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert the input image is exactly 1280×720 (and ideally hash-pin the fit constants) so a fit change fails loudly instead of mis-sampling.

findings.title: Wash+chip call pair repeated at all three draw_building fallback exits
findings.detail: Identical two-call epilogue duplicated across the host, small_biz/campus, and residential fallback branches; a future signature change must touch three sites plus the sprite path.
findings.recommended_fix: Set `foot` per branch and fall through to a single shared wash+chip epilogue before each return.
